name: WIC (Women, Infants, Children)
description: WIC is a nutrition program providing healthy food, nutrition education, breastfeeding support, and healthcare referrals to pregnant and postpartum women, infants, and children under 5 in California.
fullDescription: WIC is a nutrition program providing healthy food, nutrition education, breastfeeding support, and healthcare referrals to pregnant and postpartum women, infants, and children under 5 in California.
whatTheyOffer:
- Monthly benefits for nutritious foods (fruits, vegetables, whole grains, milk, eggs)
- Infant formula and baby food
- Nutrition education and counseling
- Breastfeeding support and breast pumps
- Health screenings and referrals
- Farmers' market benefits
- WIC card accepted at most grocery stores
howToGetIt: Contact your local WIC office, call 1-888-942-9675 (24 hours), or call 1-800-852-5770 during business hours. You'll need proof of income (up to 185% of poverty level; families on Medi-Cal or CalFresh usually qualify automatically), residency, and identity. Pregnant women, new mothers, infants, and children under 5 may qualify, and dads, grandparents, and foster parents of young children can apply too.
